item: Encrypting in place owns the machine for the whole route and waits for work in flight, and the storage guard's drain asks again once it holds its lease
summary: encrypt_all swaps the corpus file under the write gate and the route never claimed owns_the_machine(); the gate was what kept the drain out. /api/system/encrypt-db now runs inside an exclusive window (open before the pool is disposed, closed after the keyed pool is back, however the route ends) and waits up to ENCRYPT_QUIESCE_S = 180 s (the restore's figure) for corpus leases, refusing with a 409 that names them. The drain takes its lease and then asks owns_the_machine() again (lease first, then ask), and a drain that declines stamps no cadence. 7 tests; 9 mutants each killed by a named test.
